standard.title: Planning and Conducting
standard.description: suggest and follow safe procedures to investigate questions and test predictions
standard.prior_knowledge: Students have participated in guided investigations (F band). They now begin to suggest procedures — not just follow them — and contribute to safety planning.
standard.progression_endpoint: Students suggest steps for safe investigation procedures and follow guided procedures — including age-appropriate safety measures — to investigate questions and test predictions.

nodes.label: Safe procedures are suggested and followed
nodes.progression_checkpoint: Students can suggest at least one safety measure for a given investigation and follow teacher-guided steps to conduct an investigation safely.
nodes.minimum_width: Students suggest one safety measure for a given investigation and follow a guided procedure to completion.
nodes.typical_width: Students suggest safety measures (sun safety, goggles, aprons, careful equipment handling); follow steps in guided investigations; suggest ways to conduct observations safely; and contribute to setting up and packing away equipment.
wider: Explore different ways of investigating science questions through guided discussion — examining that there is more than one way to investigate
Suggest steps for setting up and packing away equipment — taking responsibility for the investigation environment
Discuss safe ways to observe the sun — applying safety reasoning to an important real investigation context
success_criteria: Suggests at least one safety measure for a named investigation and explains why it is needed
Follows guided investigation steps to completion
